rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Demolish
rules.description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Furious Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Furious. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Grounded Defense
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Grounded Defense Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Grounded Precision
rules.description: If most models in this unit are within 1" of terrain, this model gets +1 to hit rolls when attacking.

rules.name: Grounded Precision Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Grounded Precision. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: No Retreat
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

rules.name: No Retreat Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get No Retreat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Piercing Marksman
rules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

rules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Quick
rules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Quick Shot
rules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

rules.name: Quick Shot Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Slayer
rules.description: When using Hold actions and shooting, or when charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Slayer Mark
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Strider
rules.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).

rules.name: Strider Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Union Assault
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Disastrous Malfunction
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits.

spells.name: Means of Destruction
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Slayer against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psychic Smash
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 6", which take 4 hits with AP(2) each.

spells.name: Tech Zapper
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 24" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Demolish.

spells.name: Union Propaganda
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Grounded Precision once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Worker's Uprising
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which moves +2" when using Advance actions and +4" when using Rush/Charge actions once (next time the effect would apply).
